column1: # Historical and geographic names of Corsica: micro-regions, historical regions and divisions, pievi, dioceses,
# episcopal sees, Genoese provinces. Reference inventory for the Keyman keyboard dictionaries; not used by the build.
# One row per (spelling, category). See keyboard/data/historical-places.md for method, reference lists, counts and gaps.
# Built by hand on 2026-10-19 from pages read one at a time (no dictionary was queried, nothing was crawled):
#   - Collectivité Territoriale de Corse, "Cathédrales et pro-cathédrales de Corse", 2008 (dioceses and sees);
#   - Università di Corsica, M3C notice 95519 (Aiti); Office de tourisme Pasquale Paoli, page Rustinu / Vallerustie;
#   - Vikipedia (co): Lista di e pieve di Corsica (after G. Moracchini-Mazel 1967 and A. Giustiniani, tr. A.-M. Graziani
#     1993), Template:Pievi di Corsica, and articles named in the reference column (revision ids given);
#   - Wikipédia (fr): Liste des pièves de Corse, Catégorie:Piève de Corse, Microrégions de Corse, Corse (province),
#     Deçà/Delà des Monts, Géographie de la Corse, Sambucucciu d'Alandu, Noblesse corse, Histoire de la Corse;
#   - keyboard/data/sources/places.tsv (Wikidata co labels): cited as corroboration only; a Wikidata label alone gives
# usage: co | co-historical | fr | it | la (language of THIS spelling). status: accepted (attested as a name of this
# place in this category) | uncertain (single or weak attestation, or disputed) | deferred (historical spelling or out of
# scope for the keyboard). canonical: preferred Corsican form; empty when no Corsican form was attested.
# Apostrophes are ASCII (U+0027), as in the rest of keyboard/data.
